draft: Three assertions I wrote today all passed for six hours, then CI killed every one of them on the three-machine matrix. The first compared a value against a variable the test framework doesn't define, so it was really comparing against an empty string. The second asserted a fallback chain was never walked, in a configuration that had no fallback chain. The third searched a receipt for a field the receipt never emits. None of them would have failed on a single machine; all three fell on the matrix that was already there for other reasons.
